invariants: Every representation references an included file and its exact SHA-256 digest.
A vector master may link raster sources; list each dependency and do not describe the whole visual as all-vector.
A raster source preserves its original bytes, pixel dimensions, color mode, and source provenance.
A derived export identifies its source files, generator, output format, and page mapping when applicable.
A derived export may be rasterized and must say so when that is how the output was rendered.
Do not auto-trace or otherwise replace an approved raster mark without a separately approved vector master.
